source: version and description from Postgres public."SDKVersion"; pushed_date from the package registry publish date, falling back to CHANGELOG.md, git tags, then manifest history

sdk_versions.description: Fixed setAdditionalData on Android by aligning the native bridge argument key.
Expanded attribution responses with ad-network campaign, ad set, and creative IDs and names for campaign-level reporting.
Breaking change: payment capture now requires a non-empty paymentId so every payment can be uniquely identified.
Added setCustomerUserId, which persists the application user ID and automatically includes it with subsequent tracked events.
Updated the Android SDK to encrypt SDK credentials at rest with AndroidKeyStore.
Added the handleDeeplink API for processing incoming deep links and resolving re-engagement attribution.
Added the Netcore device GUID to user data so Linkrunner users can be matched with Netcore profiles.
Added optional event data to payment capture for Meta Commerce Event Manager.
Added Google Analytics session ID collection so Linkrunner events can be correlated with analytics sessions.
Added Meta view-through attribution so eligible conversions can be attributed to ad impressions without a click.
Updated the Android SDK to fix TypeToken obfuscation errors.
Updated LinkrunnerKit to support Apple Search Ads attribution.
Removed unused dependencies, models, and native modules to reduce package size and simplify maintenance.
Added the option to disable Android advertising ID collection.
Added an iOS initialization option to disable IDFA collection when advertising identifiers are not required.
Added Braze device ID, Google Analytics app instance ID, and custom-event ID support.
Added iOS push-token forwarding for uninstall tracking.
Improved platform and version initialization, updated native dependencies, and removed getVersion.
Added an API to register or update device push tokens for uninstall tracking and messaging integrations.
Added Android backup rules to keep Linkrunner SharedPreferences out of device backups and restores.
Added the SECOND_PAYMENT type so follow-up payments can be classified separately from initial and recurring payments.
Updated the native SDKs with automatic API retries and stability improvements for transient request failures.
Added the initialization debug option and expanded user-data fields.
Implemented the native Android bridge and Flutter plugin integration.
Added an API for retrieving the campaign and source data attributed to the current installation.
Cleaned up pubspec configuration and updated device_info_plus.
Synchronized the published package version with the version reported by the SDK at runtime.
Introduced trackEvent, signup, setUserData, and triggerDeeplink, expanded attribution metrics, and deprecated the legacy trigger API.
Included resolved campaign data in initialization results so applications can use attribution immediately after startup.
Internal package maintenance release; no public API or runtime behavior changes were documented.
Lowered the minimum supported Dart and Flutter versions.
Updated installation and integration guidance to match the current Flutter plugin configuration.
Removed the deprecated Google Ads deferred-deeplink implementation.
Adjusted the shared_preferences version for wider compatibility.
Added install instance ID support for consistently identifying an application installation.
Removed unused Firebase dependencies to reduce the plugin dependency footprint and avoid host-app version conflicts.
Documented Android install-referrer setup so campaign attribution can be configured correctly during integration.
Added beta Google Ads tracking support for including advertising campaign data in attribution.
Added payment capture APIs for sending revenue and transaction details to Linkrunner.
Documented how to enable or disable automatic deep-link triggering during SDK integration.
Removed the carrier_info dependency to simplify installation and avoid unnecessary native compatibility constraints.
Corrected plugin registration, packaging, and integration issues found in the initial Flutter releases.
Added singleton SDK access, React Native API parity, and device-data collection.
Initial Flutter plugin release establishing the Dart API and native Android and iOS bridge structure.
